newsitem.title: USA: PDS Fin'l gets new $20 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: PDS Fin'l gets new $20 mln credit facility.

text.p: PDS Financial Corp said Tuesday it has put in place a $20 million revolving credit facility with BNY Financial Corp, a subsidiary of the Bank of New York Co Inc.
This new three-way facility increases PDS's revolving borrowing capability to $46 million from $26 million.

It will be used to expand the company's SlotLease program, which the company designed specifically for the gaming industry. SlotLease provides recurring revenues and cash flow throughout the lease term, which the company invests primarily in gaming equipment under operating leases.
